content.short: HypeRPC provides low-latency RPC and archival node infrastructure dedicated to Hyperliquid.
content.description: HypeRPC is an RPC provider focused on a single network rather than a long chain list, offering HyperEVM endpoints tuned for latency-sensitive workloads such as trading and liquidation bots. Teams generally reach for a dedicated provider once the public endpoint's rate limits start shaping their architecture.
content.meta: HypeRPC is a dedicated Hyperliquid RPC provider offering low-latency and archival endpoints.
